english.title: Operator or pilot of passenger helicopter which took off or landed at night in place not sufficiently lit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a helicopter, namely **(..SPECIFY HELICOPTER..), flying for the purpose of the public transport of passengers at night and which

(C)_[landed at]_
(D)_[took off from]_

**(..SPECIFY PLACE..), a place intended to be used for the take-off or landing of helicopters at night when such lighting as would enable

(E)_[the pilot of the helicopter to identify the landing area in flight, to determine the landing direction and to make a safe approach and landing]_
(F)_[you to identify the landing area in flight, to determine the landing direction and to make a safe approach and landing]_
(G)_[the pilot of the helicopter to make a safe take-off]_
(H)_[you to make safe take-off]_

was not in operation
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 210(2) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
